name: casino-instrumentation-score
description: Runtime instrumentation score for the casino telemetry — four anchor rules (RES/SPA/LOG/MET) each as a pass_ratio tile, plus the weighted-score formula. The runtime guard that complements the Step-3 Weaver build-time guard. See the lab README. Deployed with dtctl.

header.content:
# 🎯 Vegas Casino — Instrumentation Score

The **runtime guard** on the `casino.*` contract (complements the Step-3 Weaver build-time guard). Four anchor rules, one per signal family, each a `pass_ratio` ∈ [0,1] over the last 30 min. Weighted into one score per service — see the note tile below. Deployed with `dtctl` (Catalog D1).

formula.content:
## Weighted score

`score = Σ(weightᵢ × pass_ratioᵢ) / Σweightᵢ × 100`

| Rule | Family | Impact | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|
| RES-001 `service.name` present | Resource | Critical | **40** |
| Span status recorded (server) | Span | Important | **30** |
| Log ↔ trace correlation | Log | Normal | **20** |
| `casino.bet.tier` present + bounded | Metric | Important | **30** |

**Bands:** ≥ 90 Excellent · 75–89 Good · 50–74 Needs work · < 50 Poor.

DQL is single-source (one `fetch` per query), so each anchor is its own tile and the composite is this formula — not one query. The LOG anchor reads `fetch logs`; the other three read `fetch spans`.

res_ratio.title: RES-001 · service.name present (Critical w=40)
res_ratio.query: fetch spans, from: now() - 30m | summarize total = count(), missing = countIf(isNull(service.name)) | fieldsAdd pass_ratio = (total - missing) / total | fields pass_ratio

spa_ratio.title: SPA · span status recorded (Important w=30)
spa_ratio.query: fetch spans, from: now() - 30m | filter span.kind == "server" | summarize total = count(), recorded = countIf(span.status_code != "UNSET") | fieldsAdd pass_ratio = recorded / total | fields pass_ratio

log_ratio.title: LOG · trace_id on logs (Normal w=20)
log_ratio.query: fetch logs, from: now() - 30m | summarize total = count(), correlated = countIf(isNotNull(trace_id)) | fieldsAdd pass_ratio = correlated / total | fields pass_ratio

met_ratio.title: MET · casino.bet.tier present + bounded (Important w=30)
met_ratio.query: fetch spans, from: now() - 30m | summarize present = countIf(isNotNull(casino.bet.tier)), total = count(), distinct_tier = countDistinct(casino.bet.tier) | fieldsAdd pass_ratio = present / total, bounded = (distinct_tier <= 8) | fields pass_ratio, bounded

score_by_service.title: Span-sourced score by service (RES+SPA+MET, w=40/30/30)
score_by_service.query: fetch spans, from: now() - 30m | summarize res = (count() - countIf(isNull(service.name))) / count(), spa = countIf(span.status_code != "UNSET" and span.kind == "server") / countIf(span.kind == "server"), met = countIf(isNotNull(casino.bet.tier)) / count(), by: { service.name } | fieldsAdd score = (40 * res + 30 * spa + 30 * met) / 90 * 100 | fieldsAdd band = if(score >= 90, "Excellent", else: if(score >= 75, "Good", else: if(score >= 50, "Needs work", else: "Poor"))) | fields service.name, score, band | sort score desc
